criteria.statement: Loopback wire checks verify redaction of every question text field, refuse secret-bearing identifiers, and retain existing verdict semantics.

review_provenance: Author self-review; not an independent security review.

findings.summary: Credential patterns were removed only from state. Text fields are now redacted; identifier credentials refuse provider access before judgment reservation. Synthetic loopback tests reproduce both paths.
Pattern matching cannot identify arbitrary secrets or establish consent for sharing personal data. Callers must minimize and sanitize provider-bound input.
